scene: Pale gray studio backdrop with a rounded charcoal inset for a visible product detail
composition: Oversized dark headline at top; source product large across center and right; short facts at left and a small detail inset below
lighting: Soft even studio light with gentle floor shadows and natural surface highlights
style: Clean fashion editorial with bold uppercase headings, compact fact labels and a rounded detail panel
avoid: verbatim reference text, dates, brand or demonstration product claims
invented specifications, materials, sizes, prices or color variants
unrelated products, unsupported angles or hidden product details
changes to source product identity, geometry, colors or branding
models or body parts absent from the source photo
carousel dots, zoom controls or other interface elements
